subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `normalizeMessageActionRequest` as a public Channel Plugin SDK contract for owner-specific action rewriting before shared dispatch?
rationale: This is a new cross-plugin API seam rather than a mechanical Telegram-only regression fix, so maintainers must choose its long-term contract and ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve the SDK seam
options.body: Accept the generic hook as a supported Plugin SDK API, document its ordering and invariants, and keep the compatibility tests.

options.title: Narrow the repair boundary
options.body: Replace the broad public hook with a narrower channel-owned mechanism that solves Telegram’s incidental-location case without creating a general rewrite contract.

recommendation.title: Narrow the repair boundary
recommendation.body: Replace the broad public hook with a narrower channel-owned mechanism that solves Telegram’s incidental-location case without creating a general rewrite contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor has the most direct implementation context, but a core/plugin SDK owner should make the final contract decision.
